question: What are the AKTU backlog and promotion rules?
answer: AKTU Backlog/Promotion Rules (CBCS system, 2016-17 onwards): (1) A student must score minimum 30 marks in both theory and practical for each subject to pass. (2) Under CBCS, promotion to the next semester is based on earned credits — there is no strict year-back rule. (3) Students with backlogs can be promoted if they have the minimum required credits. (4) Back paper exams are held with the next semester exams. (5) Grace marks of up to 10 marks total across subjects can be awarded if it results in a pass. (6) All backlogs must be cleared to receive the degree. (7) Maximum programme duration is typically 6 years for a 4-year B.Tech. For old (Non-CBCS) schemes, a maximum of 4 backlogs were allowed for promotion. Always verify with the AKTU website (aktu.ac.in) for current rules.

question: What is the AKTU re-evaluation (challenge evaluation) fee?
answer: AKTU Challenge Evaluation (Re-evaluation) fee is Rs 2,500 per subject. Under this process, two subject experts independently re-evaluate the answer sheet and the average is taken as final marks. If the marks difference after re-evaluation exceeds 20% of total marks, a refund of Rs 1,500 is given. Students can apply through the AKTU ERP portal (erp.aktu.ac.in) within the stipulated window after results are declared. Note: Challenge evaluation marks are final and binding — no further appeal is allowed.
